title: 4th Board of Director's meet Oct 2016
summary: 4th meeting of Board of Directors was conducted in a lively environment.
description:
4th meeting of Board of Directors was conducted in a lively environment. Members freely participated expressing their views, opinions... decisions taken in the larger interest of the club. The BOD was hosted by Hon. Club Secetary Rtn. Pooja Sthalekar and spouse PP Rtn. Durgesh Sthalekar.
The meeting concluded with profound vote of thanks to the host and the sumptuous dinner sponsored by them.
The meeting was held at our regular meeting venue .. Vidya Mandir, Dahisar East.
